questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.learningObjective: Compute total from a two-way table
questions.stem: A memo two-way table has 30 bus+late, 70 bus+on time, 20 train+late, 80 train+on time. How many bus riders?
questions.explanation: The rule that settles this two-way tables and conditional rates item is: Add the bus row. That is why "100" is the answer.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.learningObjective: Compute probability of a path with three branches
questions.stem: A tree has P(A)=0.5, then P(B|A)=0.4, then P(C|A and B)=0.5. What is P(A and B and C)?
questions.explanation: Applying the probability trees rule — Multiply all three branch probabilities — yields "0.1". Reversing the reasoning would recover the given quantities.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.learningObjective: Compute a count from a circle graph percent
questions.stem: A memo circle graph shows 15% for biking. In 240 commuters, how many bike?
questions.explanation: The circle graphs principle here is: Take 15% of 240. On that basis "36" is correct.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.learningObjective: Compute P(A|B) when B is rare
questions.stem: A memo table: 200 people, 10 bike, 2 bike and bus. What is P(bus|bike)?
questions.explanation: For a conditional probability question like this, the governing rule is: Divide by the bike count. Applying it gives "0.2" as the answer.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED_1
questions.learningObjective: Interpret a bar graph trend
questions.stem: A memo bar graph shows ridership rising from 2019 to 2023. What does that indicate?

options.misconception: confuses "Ridership stayed flat" with the correct "Ridership increased over the years"
names "Ridership decreased over the years" where the rule requires "Ridership increased over the years"
bar graphs show trends over time

questions.explanation: Applying the bar graphs rule — Look at the direction of bars — yields "Ridership increased over the years". The tempting "Ridership stayed flat" fails because it confuses "Ridership stayed flat" with the correct "Ridership increased over the years".
questions.hint: Look at the direction of bars.
